summary: The speaker argues that the historical practice of state-supported churches led to a decline in voluntary giving, yet this mentality is spiritually flawed because Christians should dedicate all resources to serving the Lord rather than calculating minimum or maximum amounts. The discussion emphasizes that all possessions are sanctified through the Incarnation and belong to God, urging believers to adopt a mindset of true generosity instead of restricting themselves due to bills or family needs. The speaker shares a personal example of making the joint decision with his wife to tithe 10%, noting that this choice allowed them to trust that God would provide for their needs.
